input.title: feat: show authored creator part details
input.body:
## Summary

Show the authored part-details panel in the live creator.

```text
palette hover / keyboard focus → source row anchor + fresh detail instance
details865 → seven fields + separately masked arrow + animated49×49 thumbnail
leave / placement / tab / dialog → clear details
```

Selection-info popovers and the tank viewer follow separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** creator rows only supplied browser-title descriptions; the recovered details layout and artwork had no live editor consumer.
  **After:** unlocked rows show original damage/summary/flavor, class wording and complexity labels, with selected/unselected arrow poses and affordability alpha.
- Formatting, TypeScript,527 rule/parser tests (6,344 assertions), production build and all12 unique affected browser cases pass without skips. Eight existing palette/tab/control cases pass; the final four native/mock details and locked-focus cases pass in24.6s.
- Browser checks verify panel(189,253)/222×186 geometry,49×49 thumbnail mask and paint, fresh instance keys on selection/re-entry, keyboard descriptions, dimmed selectable rows, current-row wheel rollover, placement/exit cleanup and locked-row exclusion. Native/mock captures inspected.
- TankCreatorScreen._-Gn592–699 and rollover/out handlers determine text, row-relative arrow alpha/position and fresh thumbnail construction. ScrollJump2Percentage1183–1190 moves the library; new pointer rollover can reopen details under a stationary cursor. Keyboard focus is a browser adapter.
- Mock fallback adds a basic panel border/divider and procedural arrow from numerical layout/colors. The source845 divider registration is documented;0.1px arrow neck notches and static-label font substitution remain mock approximations. Complete original-runtime font/input/paint comparison remains unproven. No generated data, source vectors, media, profile or simulation changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the previous creator presentation. No saved-data migration.

**Blast Radius:** creator

Adds the live tooltip and reuses the existing lazy artwork renderer/frame clock. Existing palette selection, previews, placement and game rules remain unchanged.

output.body:
## Summary

Recover the source-authored details artwork and independent thumbnail clip layer.

```text
supplied SWF → panel / two arrows / selection icon / popup caches
fresh detail clip → initial dominant dimension capped at48px → retained animation
new focus → destroy old clip → construct again
```

The live details and selection-info UI follows separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** both native/mock regressions fail with previous full-size rendering (66/67px rather than at most50 painted pixels).
  **After:** restore the renderer byte-for-byte; both pass. Small parts remain unexpanded, palette previews stay full size, repeated frames retain clips, animation advances, and new focus/clear restarts or removes them.
- Formatting, TypeScript,527 rule/parser tests (6,344 assertions), production build and all nine unique affected browser cases pass without skips. Existing49 control,45 palette,39 enemy and four dialog cache checks remain green; live controls retain their browser checks. The final focused pair also verifies arrow colors.
- Independently recovered raw SWF bounds confirm background845 (205×186), arrows857/858 (26.2×20), icon1002 (14.05×15) and scaled popup1000. The full222px details container also includes the separately rendered arrow. Named fields/dynamic children are excluded; unoccupied masks do not paint opaque black.
- TankCreatorScreen._-Gn677–699 constructs a new clip and shrinks only its initial dominant dimension to48. Its later animation retains that scale. A synchronous fixture fixes constructor randomness and restores it in finally; production randomness is unchanged.
- Native/mock gallery captures inspected. No source media or generated data changes. Complete original-runtime screen comparison and live UI integration remain pending.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the additional caches/layer; no profile migration.

**Blast Radius:** creator

Adds five supplied-SWF cache entries and a separate detail clip layer. Existing rendering modes and simulation remain unchanged.

## Summary

Show the authored part-details panel in the live creator.

```text
palette hover / keyboard focus → source row anchor + fresh detail instance
details865 → seven fields + separately masked arrow + animated49×49 thumbnail
leave / placement / tab / dialog → clear details
```

Selection-info popovers and the tank viewer follow separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** creator rows only supplied browser-title descriptions; the recovered details layout and artwork had no live editor consumer.
  **After:** unlocked rows show original damage/summary/flavor, class wording and complexity labels, with selected/unselected arrow poses and affordability alpha.
- Formatting, TypeScript,527 rule/parser tests (6,344 assertions), production build and all12 unique affected browser cases pass without skips. Eight existing palette/tab/control cases pass; the final four native/mock details and locked-focus cases pass in24.6s.
- Browser checks verify panel(189,253)/222×186 geometry,49×49 thumbnail mask and paint, fresh instance keys on selection/re-entry, keyboard descriptions, dimmed selectable rows, current-row wheel rollover, placement/exit cleanup and locked-row exclusion. Native/mock captures inspected.
- TankCreatorScreen._-Gn592–699 and rollover/out handlers determine text, row-relative arrow alpha/position and fresh thumbnail construction. ScrollJump2Percentage1183–1190 moves the library; new pointer rollover can reopen details under a stationary cursor. Keyboard focus is a browser adapter.
- Mock fallback adds a basic panel border/divider and procedural arrow from numerical layout/colors. The source845 divider registration is documented;0.1px arrow neck notches and static-label font substitution remain mock approximations. Complete original-runtime font/input/paint comparison remains unproven. No generated data, source vectors, media, profile or simulation changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the previous creator presentation. No saved-data migration.

**Blast Radius:** creator

Adds the live tooltip and reuses the existing lazy artwork renderer/frame clock. Existing palette selection, previews, placement and game rules remain unchanged.
